name: blended-union-any-order
why: A blend rounds the seam of the whole union, made as one boolean. Joined one operand at a time, the two bosses listed first fused into a pair with no seam, blending that failed ('no suitable edges'), and the part was refused while union(plate, left, right) built. The volume matches that order's to tessellation (15714.56 mm³ measured there before this change); two 2 mm fillet rings on 5 mm bosses have no closed form worth trusting here.
